summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience optimizing and deploying AI models across edge and hybrid AI architectures. Fine-tuned vision-language models (DONUT), compressed LLMs via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization, and built production-grade inference pipelines using TensorRT and CUDA C++ on NVIDIA Jetson.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free vision-language transformer) on a custom dataset; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing and architecture tuning.
Built PyTorch preprocessing and training pipelines to standardize model training, evaluation, and reproducibility workflows.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained and evaluated YOLOv8 computer vision models, improving classification accuracy from 78% to 97.5%; deployed to a production consumer mobile app.
Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset for health-level classification.

experience.title: Research Intern
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and ZoeDepth depth estimation; achieved PSNR of 86 vs. 65 (homography baseline).
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller.

Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), and TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced TinyLlama 1.1B memory footprint by ~25% via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization for edge deployment.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; characterized ~7% accuracy drop and +6.3 perplexity increase to quantify compression trade-offs.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights, and preallocated global buffers.
Achieved ~35% speedup (49.2ms vs 73.3ms uncoalesced; 77.5ms CPU baseline) — 1.5–2× improvement in convolution throughput with identical accuracy.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
